notes: Every floor prompt is self-contained. To keep floors visually aligned when generating with Imagen / Nano Banana / Midjourney, DO NOT change: the 90m x 60m footprint, the 16:9 aspect ratio, the fixed vertical-circulation positions (elevators, stairwells, service shafts), the grid coordinate system (A-P across, 1-12 down), the title-block position (bottom-right), or the color palette. If your generator lets you attach a reference image, feed it the Ground Floor render for floors 2-6.
